scenes: In twenty ten, a website gave away free bitcoin. To anyone.
All you had to do was solve a captcha.
It was called the Bitcoin Faucet. A programmer named Gavin Andresen built it.
He filled it with eleven hundred of his own coins.
Even Satoshi Nakamoto replied, with tips to stop cheaters.
Back then, five bitcoin were worth less than a dollar.
In total, it gave away about nineteen thousand seven hundred bitcoin.
Today, that's over one point four billion dollars.
Those five free coins? Over three hundred and sixty thousand dollars.
Why give it away? He wanted people to try it out.
